newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank leaves repo rate at fixed 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank leaves repo rate at fixed 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set its one-week key repurchase rate at a fixed unchanged 4.10 percent.
No market players had expected a change, a Reuter poll of analysts showed.

The central bank's deposit rate stands at 3.75 percent while its lending rate is 5.25 percent. The Riksbank last cut the repo rate on December 17 last year by 25 basis points. Last year the Riksbank cut the rate 25 times.
